sentences.en: We were taught that Newton discovered the law of gravity.
sentences.zh: 我们曾被教导牛顿发现了万有引力定律。

sentences.en: If you can use gravity to your advantage, do so.
sentences.zh: 如果你能利用重力的优势，就利用它。

sentences.en: The first space stations rotated axially to produce artificial gravity.
sentences.zh: 早期的空间站通过轴向旋转来制造人造重力。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：grav（重）+ity（表名词）→重力
